procedural_matters: Hearing request was lodge on the Penalty Report form. As it met all the requirements of RRS 60.3(a) and as RRS does not prescribe a specific form for a hearing request (Preamble of part 5) it was accepted as a protest.
Technical committee represented by Peter Möckl.
facts: After the race no. 3 Technical Committee inspected boat ARG 8239.
ARG 8239 was not able to present personal flotation device when requested by the Technical Committee.
conclusions: By not having personal flotation device on board ARG 8239 broke class rule 31.2.2(a)
decision: Using the WS Discretionary Penalty Policy, a starting penalty of 20% was decided for races sailed in September 11th for ARG 8239. There were no reason to increase or decrease penalty.
